 ā, f. pl. (± 🞄upaniṣad) secret doctrine sung by the Adorable 🞄One (Kṛṣṇa), T. of a well-known theosophical 🞄poem forming an episode in the 🞄Mahābhārata.

 splendid, glorious: -ī, f. sister 🞄(happy, as not being an only child but 🞄having a brother): -pati, m. sisterʼs husband, 🞄brother-in-law, -suta, m. sisterʼs son, nephew.

 m. follower of the Adorable One, 🞄Vaiṣṇava monk.
